biography.plain_text: Donald Trump is an American property businessman and the 45th and 47th president of the United States. A University of Pennsylvania graduate, he expanded his father Fred's property business into Manhattan. His billionaire fortune combines substantial family transfers with later development, licensing and media ventures; his private residence is in Palm Beach.

long_biography.plain_text:
On NBC's The Apprentice, Donald Trump turned the boardroom into a television setting. As host and executive producer, he assessed contestants through business challenges and dismissed one each week. The programme began in 2004 and led to a celebrity version, extending his public identity beyond property development.

In 1986, Trump undertook the renovation of Central Park's Wollman Rink. His team used established subcontractors, paid them promptly and sent specialists to Canada to select refrigeration equipment. The work finished in three and a half months, allowing the city-owned rink to reopen that autumn.
long_biography.html:
On NBC's The Apprentice, Donald Trump turned the boardroom into a television setting. As host and executive producer, he assessed contestants through business challenges and dismissed one each week. The programme began in 2004 and led to a celebrity version, extending his public identity beyond property development.

In 1986, Trump undertook the renovation of Central Park's Wollman Rink. His team used established subcontractors, paid them promptly and sent specialists to Canada to select refrigeration equipment. The work finished in three and a half months, allowing the city-owned rink to reopen that autumn.

uncertainties: Research cutoff is 30 September 2026; sources were accessed on 1 October. Public office is included solely as a defining formal identity. No political advocacy, allegations, crimes, medical or religious claims are proposed.

Current industry is a qualitative classification from positively material personally attributable assets, not an exact balance sheet. The September Forbes categories include roughly USD 1.8 billion in golf/resorts, USD 1.1 billion in property investments and USD 1 billion in media equity. The USD 2.4 billion crypto-and-liquid category includes USD 1.9 billion of liquidity and must not be described as cryptocurrency alone.

Mixed is selected over advantaged self-made because actual material family assets were transferred, and over exclusively family transfer because independently created media, branding and financial ventures became substantial. No precise proportion is asserted. Original property wealth and present sector composition are assessed separately.

The strongest current relationship alternative is Operator or Founder. Positive retained economic ownership plus explicitly delegated management supports Passive asset owner for the research date. The plan is not a blind trust or an independent audit of informal influence. Public duties do not by themselves determine the label.

All person-relevant supported types were searched: LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube and TikTok. LinkedIn results include his son, the campaign organisation, unrelated professionals and unverified namesakes; none is assigned personally. Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow checks yielded institutional archives, media and property pages rather than a verified personal profile.

Social verification uses explicit account links, primary channel metadata and independent account reporting where platform access is limited. Company handles and White House/POTUS accounts are not substituted for his personal accounts. Truth Social has no supported input type and is not forced into another type. The personal website is a political website, not a corporate portfolio site.

Secondary nationality is not inferred from parental ancestry. The current private Palm Beach base is distinct from temporary residence for public duties; the existing US country fields require no change.

The input vessel relationship starts in 1987, while commonly cited purchase histories give 1988. The exact start date is not amended; the independent former-name and named-owner bridge is decisive without relying on that discrepancy.

Only three useful active tags are assigned. Other material business interests remain in the wealth evidence rather than an exhaustive set of overlapping sector and role tags. The property and presenting tags describe historically defining practices, not current management claims.

The long profile omits current politics, net-worth figures, inherited assets, education and home location. Its public-project passage stays within the contemporary TIME article's derivative limit, and source wording is not copied.
